name: Haunted Hearts
source:
To solve your own murder, you’ll need the help of three ghosts – and the only way to win them over is to seduce them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
为了查清自己被杀的真相，你需要三个鬼魂的帮忙。让它们站到你这边的唯一办法，就是色诱它们。
